<span style="color:darkblue"><font face="courier"> <font size="4">***i***</font></font></span> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
Select two contrasts from your input data, choose a test type and whether to apply Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR correction. DeeDee performs a Rank-Rank Hypergeometric Overlap analysis and returns a heatmap showing the significance of overlap between the two contrasts across all possible rank thresholds.
